thing-type.label: EEBus Controllable System
thing-type.description: A local EEBus SHIP/SPINE node that presents openHAB as an EEBus Controllable System (CS). A remote CEM/EMS or smart-meter CLS gateway pairs with this node and issues LPC/LPP power limits.

channel.label: LPC State
channel.description: State of the Limitation of Power Consumption controllable-system state machine.

channel.label: LPC Active Limit
channel.description: The currently active consumption power limit.

channel.label: LPC Active Limit Duration
channel.description: ISO 8601 duration the current consumption limit remains valid for, if any.

channel.label: LPC Event
channel.description: Fires when the LPC state machine transitions state.

channel.label: LPP State
channel.description: State of the Limitation of Power Production controllable-system state machine.

channel.label: LPP Active Limit
channel.description: The currently active production power limit.

channel.label: LPP Active Limit Duration
channel.description: ISO 8601 duration the current production limit remains valid for, if any.

channel.label: LPP Event
channel.description: Fires when the LPP state machine transitions state.

parameter.name: bindAddress
parameter.label: Bind Address
parameter.description: Local IP address the SHIP WebSocket server binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 to bind all interfaces.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port

parameter.name: wssPath
parameter.label: WebSocket Path
parameter.description: HTTP path the SHIP WebSocket endpoint is served under.

parameter.name: serviceDomain
parameter.label: mDNS Domain
parameter.description: mDNS domain used for SHIP service advertisement/discovery.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: Unique SPINE device identifier for this node. Change the default to something unique to your installation before pairing with a real EEBus partner.

parameter.name: friendlyName
parameter.label: Friendly Name
parameter.description: Human-readable name advertised to pairing partners.

parameter.name: deviceType
parameter.label: SPINE Device Type
parameter.description: SPINE device type reported to pairing partners.

parameter.name: entityType
parameter.label: SPINE Entity Type
parameter.description: SPINE entity type hosting the LPC/LPP use cases. Limited to the entity types the jEEBus LPC/LPP implementation actually allows (verified live against a real EEBus partner) - CEM is the correct default for a generic controllable system; pick a more specific type (e.g. EVSE, HEAT_PUMP_APPLIANCE) if your partner requires it.

parameter.name: connectPolicy
parameter.label: Connect Policy

parameter.name: trustedSkis
parameter.label: Trusted SKIs
parameter.description: Comma-separated list of remote SHIP Subject Key Identifiers (SKIs) to pre-trust, e.g. the SKI printed on your CLS gateway. Only used when Connect Policy is "Trusted SKIs only".

parameter.name: autoAcceptPairing
parameter.label: Auto-Accept Pairing Requests
parameter.description: Accept any pairing request without a pre-trusted SKI. Only intended for lab testing against a simulator - never enable this against a production installation.

parameter.name: lpcEnabled
parameter.label: Enable LPC
parameter.description: Expose the Limitation of Power Consumption use case.

parameter.name: lpcNominalMaxWatts
parameter.label: Nominal Max Consumption
parameter.description: The maximum power this installation could ever consume, reported to the CEM as the LPC nominal max value.

parameter.name: lpcFailsafeLimitWatts
parameter.label: Failsafe Consumption Limit
parameter.description: Limit applied automatically if the pairing partner stops sending heartbeats. Review and lower this to a value your installation's wiring/fuse can safely sustain unattended - it does NOT default to a safe value automatically.

parameter.name: lpcFailsafeDuration
parameter.label: Failsafe Duration
parameter.description: ISO 8601 duration the failsafe limit is considered valid for after communication is lost (e.g. PT2H for 2 hours).

parameter.name: lppEnabled
parameter.label: Enable LPP
parameter.description: Expose the Limitation of Power Production use case.

parameter.name: lppNominalMaxWatts
parameter.label: Nominal Max Production
parameter.description: The maximum power this installation could ever feed in, reported to the CEM as the LPP nominal max value.

parameter.name: lppFailsafeLimitWatts
parameter.label: Failsafe Production Limit
parameter.description: Limit applied automatically if the pairing partner stops sending heartbeats. Review and set this to a value appropriate for your installation - it does NOT default to a safe value automatically.

parameter.name: lppFailsafeDuration
parameter.label: Failsafe Duration
parameter.description: ISO 8601 duration the failsafe limit is considered valid for after communication is lost (e.g. PT2H for 2 hours).

channel-type.label: Own SKI
channel-type.description: This node's own Subject Key Identifier. Give this to your CLS gateway/EMS installer to pre-trust this node.

channel-type.label: Controllable System State
channel-type.description: Current state of the controllable-system state machine.

channel-type.label: Active Limit
channel-type.description: Currently active power limit as reported by the state machine.

channel-type.label: Active Limit Duration
channel-type.description: ISO 8601 duration the active limit remains valid for, if reported by the pairing partner.

channel-type.label: Controllable System Event
channel-type.description: Fires whenever the controllable-system state machine processes an event.
